new_sources.EXACT_TITLE: How a lean learning system can improve operators’ work performance and well-being in a production setting
new_sources.DATE_VERSION_EDITION: Online 2026-04-10; International Journal of Quality & Reliability Management 43(6), 1569–1592; DOI 10.1108/IJQRM-05-2024-0165
new_sources.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: Describes a favorable learning-system transformation using manager interviews and internal documents.

new_sources.EXACT_TITLE: Lean but strained: a socio-technical explanation of the safety paradox in just-in-time modular construction
new_sources.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: Reports positive JIT associations with perceived safety and strain across 103 modular-construction firms; strain also relates positively to reported safety, contrary to the proposed negative path.
new_sources.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_OR_LIMIT: Four-week lag and perceptual measures do not identify causality or long-term health. Compensatory vigilance is a proposed explanation, not an observed mechanism; no endorsement of overload follows.
